ns2:course.label: Chemistry of Soil Fertility
ns2:course.description: The chemistry of essential plant nutrients in soils, and their quantitative relationships to plant growth. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: NRES 201 and CHEM 222.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: NRES 201 and CHEM 222.
